lines.en: : The most of what?! Do you have any idea what you’re doing right now?!
lines.zh: : 「最多」的什么?!你知道你现在在干什么吗?!

lines.en: : Alas! I don’t! If only there was a teacher here to- ah! I’ve found one! Oh, I crack myself up.
lines.zh: : 唉!我不知道!要是有个老师在就好了——啊!找到一个!哦,我自己都把自己逗笑了。

lines.en: : Am I interrupting, Mother? Should I step back out and come inside again?
lines.zh: : 我打扰你们了吗,妈妈?要我退出去、再重新进来吗?

lines.en: : Oh! Tsukasa, dear. I was having so much fun I didn’t hear you enter.
lines.zh: : 哦!Tsukasa,亲爱的。我玩得太开心了,没听见你进来。

lines.en: : Akira and I were actually just discussing your education and how important it is that we prepare you for every aspect of life and not just the...academic parts. Isn’t that right, Akira?
lines.zh: : Akira 和我其实正在聊你的教育——聊「为人生的每一个方面、而不只是学术部分做好准备」有多重要。对吧,Akira?

lines.en: : No. It’s not. That’s something you were talking about. Tsukasa doesn’t want to learn about this stuff from me.
lines.zh: : 不。不是。那是你一个人在聊。Tsukasa 不想跟我学这种东西。

lines.en: : What stuff? I’m not really sure what’s going on right now. Was I supposed to have lessons today?
lines.zh: : 哪种东西?我到现在都不明白在发生什么。我今天有课吗?

lines.en: : You weren’t, no. But your tutor here was so concerned about your education that he came all the way over just to talk to me about it. Isn’t that kind of him?
lines.zh: : 没有。但你的家教非常关心你的教育,特意跑来找我谈。他人很好吧?

lines.en: : You really did that, Jeeves? Mother is very busy, you know. You should have just called me if you were that concerned.
lines.zh: : 你真的那样做了,Jeeves?妈妈很忙的,你知道吧。你要真那么关心,给我打电话就行了。

lines.en: : Without knowing what’s being discussed, however, I can not confirm nor deny whether or not I am comfortable learning something from Jeeves as I imagine there are a great deal of things I know more about than he does.
lines.zh: : 在不知道你们在聊什么的前提下,我既不能证实也不能否认「我是否愿意跟 Jeeves 学东西」——因为我想,有很多东西我懂得比他多。

lines.en: : We’re talking about the reproductive system, dear. Sex, if you will.
lines.zh: : 我们在聊生殖系统,亲爱的。性,如果你愿意这么叫。

lines.en: : Tsubasa...
lines.zh: : Tsubasa……

lines.en: : I don’t understand the concern, Akira. I’m right here to supervise the entire ordeal. What could possibly go wrong?
lines.zh: : 我不明白你担心什么,Akira。我就在这里,全程监督。能出什么岔子?

lines.en: : Is this...really how we have to do this, Mother?
lines.zh: : 这……真的必须是这种方式吗,妈妈?

lines.en: : See? Even she thinks it’s weird.
lines.zh: : 看?连她都觉得怪。

lines.en: : Does Jeeves make you uncomfortable when it comes to this subject, Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 是 Jeeves 让你在这种话题上不舒服吗,Tsukasa?

lines.en: : It’s not that I’m uncomfortable with it, Mother. Jeeves cares more about me than any other teacher I’ve ever had. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 不是不舒服,妈妈。Jeeves 比我遇到过的任何老师都在乎我。只是……

lines.en: : It’s, um...embarrassing when you’re here as well.
lines.zh: : 有你在的时候,这事……挺尴尬的。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Embarrassing? Why? I’ve sat in on plenty of your lessons in the past.
lines.zh: : 尴尬?为什么?我以前旁听过你很多次课。

lines.en: : Y...Yes! But this is...different. Isn’t it? And it’s...it’s not like I’m interested anyway! Just...somewhat curious is all.
lines.zh: : 是……是的!但这次……不一样。不是吗?而且……我也不是有兴趣!只是……有点好奇而已。

lines.en: : Well, this is as good a time as any to start asking questions, Tsukasa. Akira and I are both very busy people. And we won’t hold your curiosity against you.
lines.zh: : 嗯,现在正是提问的绝佳时机,Tsukasa。Akira 和我都是很忙的人。我们不会因为你好奇而怪你。

lines.en: : Just think of him as your father and I’m sure this entire process will feel all the more natural.
lines.zh: : 只要把他当成你的父亲,我相信整个过程会更加自然。

lines.en: : It shouldn’t be too bad if you’re just answering questions. Right, Akira?
lines.zh: : 如果你只是回答问题,应该不至于太糟。对吧,Akira?

lines.en: : Or perhaps you’d like to run to the restroom for a moment first to prevent the potential onset of any untimely distractions.
lines.zh: : 又或者,你可以先去一趟洗手间——免得任何不合时宜的干扰突然出现。

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll answer your questions, Tsukasa. But let it be known that I am doing this under duress and your mother is just as capable of teaching you these things as me.
lines.zh: : 行。我回答你的问题,Tsukasa。但请记住:我是被迫的,而且你妈妈教这些东西,和我一样称职。

lines.en: : In that case, I have several hundred questions that I have prepared in the event that something like this happens. Which order should I ask them in?
lines.zh: : 那样的话,我准备了几百个问题——以防这种事发生。我应该按什么顺序问?

lines.en: : Sorry — several hundred?
lines.zh: : 抱歉——几百个?

lines.en: : Is that too many? How many am I allowed to ask?
lines.zh: : 太多了吗?我可以问多少个?

lines.en: : Whatever the bare minimum to satisfy your mother is.
lines.zh: : 能满足你妈妈的最低数量即可。

lines.en: : I’m quite easily satisfied, Akira. I’m sure you’d have no trouble at all.
lines.zh: : 我很好满足的,Akira。我相信你毫无压力。

lines.en: : Just...go ahead, Tsukasa. Let’s get this over with.
lines.zh: : 就……开始吧,Tsukasa。我们速战速决。

lines.en: : Then...what does it feel like? It’s good, right? Is that why boys cum?
lines.zh: : 那么……那是什么感觉?很爽,对吧?所以男生才会去?

lines.en: : Yeah, Tsubasa — this is weird. There’s really no reason for me to be the one who does this even if you’re here.
lines.zh: : 你看,Tsubasa——这很怪。就算你在场,也真的没理由由我来做这件事。

lines.en: : To be honest, Jeeves, I’m probably more comfortable learning about this from you than anyone.
lines.zh: : 说实话,Jeeves,从你这里学这个,可能比从任何人那里学都让我自在。

lines.en: : You are not helping right now. Your sister hasn’t even come to me with questions like this yet and she’s far closer to the age in which people normally learn about this stuff.
lines.zh: : 你现在可没在帮忙。你姐姐到现在都还没拿这种问题来问我,而她离「正常人学这些的年纪」近多了。

lines.en: : Oh, what a splendid idea! I should have Touka join us as well. Then no one’s getting any unfair treatment!
lines.zh: : 哦,好主意!我应该让 Touka 也加入。这样谁都不会受到不公平的对待!

lines.en: : Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 求你别。

lines.en: : Touka? Can you come to my office as urgently as possible, please?
lines.zh: : Touka?能请你尽快来我的办公室一趟吗?

lines.en: : As urgently as possible? Really?
lines.zh: : 尽快?认真的吗?

lines.en: : Of course. This is time-sensitive information. Tsukasa’s growing every single day.
lines.zh: : 当然。这是时效性信息。Tsukasa 每天都在长大。

lines.en: : You wanted to see me, Mo-
lines.zh: : 你找我,妈——

lines.en: : Wait, Sensei? Why are you here?
lines.zh: : 等等,Sensei?你为什么在这里?

lines.en: : We’re having an impromptu lesson on sexual education. So if you have any questions for Akira here, now is the time to ask them.
lines.zh: : 我们在上一堂临时安排的性教育课。所以你要是对 Akira 有任何问题,现在是提问时间。

lines.en: : Obviously Touka isn’t going to-
lines.zh: : Obviously Touka 不会——

lines.en: : Oh, excellent. I actually have over a hundred questions prepared if that is okay.
lines.zh: : 哦,太好了。我 actually 准备了一百多个问题,如果不介意的话。

lines.en: : Where did that second chair even come from?
lines.zh: : 那第二把椅子是哪来的?

lines.en: : You have questions as well, Onee-sama? But you’re a teenager. Haven’t you already learned about this in school?
lines.zh: : 你也有问题,Onee-sama?可你是青少年。你不是在学校早学过吗?

lines.en: : I haven’t, no. Just the presentations we get here — which, as I’m sure you know, do not do a sufficient job of painting the whole picture.
lines.zh: : 还没有。只有这里的宣讲——而你肯定知道,它们完全没能画出全貌。

lines.en: : They are quite dated, aren’t they? How lucky we don’t need them anymore! Akira — go ahead and restate Tsukasa’s question so Touka can hear it too.
lines.zh: : 它们确实相当过时了,对吧?我们多幸运,再也不需要它们了!Akira——请把 Tsukasa 的问题重复一遍,让 Touka 也听到。

lines.en: : Can’t. Forgot it already. Lesson’s over.
lines.zh: : 不行。已经忘了。下课。

lines.en: : It was just about how sex feels, Jeeves. And if the reason boys cum is because it's extraordinarily pleasurable.
lines.zh: : 就是问性爱是什么感觉,Jeeves。以及男生之所以会去,是不是因为它爽得离谱。

lines.en: : It is, yes. That much even I can answer. I would like to know how such a thing feels for the woman, though. But I imagine Mother’s perspective on that would make more sense to us than Sensei’s.
lines.zh: : 是的。这个我都能答。不过我倒想知道,这对女方是什么感觉。但我猜,妈妈的视角比 Sensei 的更适合我们。

lines.en: : Great. Then Tsubasa can answer.
lines.zh: : 太好了。那 Tsubasa 来答。

lines.en: : She can’t. She doesn’t remember.
lines.zh: : 她答不了。她不记得了。

lines.en: : Oh! I know! Why not start by describing each step of the process? What causes it to get hard? How does it feel when it gets hard? And what about penetration? Is that the best part? I bet that’s the best part.
lines.zh: : 哦!我知道!不如我们从头描述每个步骤?是什么让它变硬的?变硬的时候是什么感觉?那进入呢?那是最爽的部分吗?我打赌那是最爽的部分。

lines.en: : There’s a clear best part and it’s not penetration. That answers Tsukasa’s question about cumming. Are we done now?
lines.zh: : 有一个明确最爽的部分,而且不是进入。这回答了 Tsukasa 关于「去」的问题。现在下课了吗?

lines.en: : Not yet! I have several hundred more if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 还没有!不介意的话,我还有几百个。

lines.en: : Question two — what’s a “blowjob?” Because I know you use your mouth, but it seems hard to have a penis in there and also blow at the same time.
lines.zh: : 第二题——什么是「口交」?因为我知道要用嘴,但嘴里含着 penis 的同时还要「吹」,看起来很难兼得。

lines.en: : I believe the exhalation provides some sort of additional stimulation if I had to take a guess.
lines.zh: : 我猜,呼气大概能提供某种额外的刺激吧。

lines.en: : You don’t actually blow on the penis. You’re not inflating a balloon. You just suck it.
lines.zh: : 你其实不用对着 penis 吹。你不是在给气球打气。你只要吸就行。

lines.en: : Oh, wow. I’m already learning so much.
lines.zh: : 哦,哇。我已经学到好多。

lines.en: : What does it taste like?
lines.zh: : 它是什么味道?

lines.en: : How am I supposed to know? I’ve never put one in my mouth.
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道?我从来没把一根放进嘴里。

lines.en: : Not even your own? Why? Is it not big enough?
lines.zh: : 连自己的都没有?为什么?是不是不够大?

lines.en: : Tsukasa! That’s incredibly rude. I imagine it’s just unsanitary to do such a thing.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa!这非常无礼。我想,那只是不太卫生。

lines.en: : But it’s not unsanitary to do it to other people? How does that work? You’re supposed to know more than me.
lines.zh: : 但对别人做就不不卫生了?这是什么道理?你应该比我懂得多。

lines.en: : Tsubasa...can I please go home now?
lines.zh: : Tsubasa……我现在可以回家了吗?

lines.en: : Tsubasa?
lines.zh: : Tsubasa?

lines.en: : How long are men supposed to last on average?
lines.zh: : 男性平均应该持续多久?

lines.en: : Mother?! Really?!
lines.zh: : 妈妈?!真的吗?!

lines.en: : What? Am I not allowed to ask questions? You girls aren’t the only ones curious about this kind of stuff. Let the record show that I’ve lived a mostly sheltered life as well.
lines.zh: : 怎么?我不许提问吗?好奇这种东西的,可不只有你们女孩。请记录在案:我也过着相当受庇护的人生。

lines.en: : Do you not have sex with Father?
lines.zh: : 你不和爸爸做吗?

lines.en: : I do not. But you never heard me say that, do you understand?
lines.zh: : 不做。但你永远没听过我说这句话,明白吗?

lines.en: : I am sorry.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉。

lines.en: : Why not? Do you two not love each other anymore?
lines.zh: : 为什么不做?你们俩不再相爱了吗?

lines.en: : Of course we do, dear. But sex doesn’t always have to be about love. Sometimes, two people are just attracted to each other and want to make each other feel good.
lines.zh: : 当然爱,亲爱的。但性并不总得关于爱。有时候,两个人只是彼此吸引、想让对方舒服。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我懂了……

lines.en: : Why not do it with Jeeves then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不找 Jeeves 做?

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么?

lines.en: : Ts...Tsukasa! That’s adultery! Mother can’t do such a thing while she’s married to Father!
lines.zh: : Ts……Tsukasa!那是通奸!妈妈和爸爸结着婚,不能做那种事!

lines.en: : Fine. Then why don’t you do it, Onee-sama? You’re not dating anyone.
lines.zh: : 那好。那你来,Onee-sama?你又没在谈恋爱。

lines.en: : That’s somehow even worse!
lines.zh: : 那更糟!

lines.en: : Ugh, fine. Then you two leave me no choice. I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 唉,行。那你们俩逼得我别无选择。我来。

lines.en: : Only if Jeeves is okay with it, though. I’ve read that consent is very important when it comes to sexual intercourse.
lines.zh: : 但前提是 Jeeves 同意。我读过,「同意」在性交中非常重要。

lines.en: : Um...no? Ew? Gross? Grow up?
lines.zh: : 呃……不?恶心?下头?你成熟点行吗?

lines.en: : Is that something you actually want to do, Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 这是 Tsukasa 真心想做的事吗?

lines.en: : Um, Mother?! Hello?! She’s a-
lines.zh: : 呃,妈妈?!喂?!她是——

lines.en: : In a moment, Touka. I’m talking to your sister right now.
lines.zh: : 稍等,Touka。我在跟你妹妹说话。

lines.en: : I don’t know what I want. I don’t know what I’m supposed to want.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我想要什么。我不知道我「应该」想要什么。

lines.en: : Because if you don’t have sex and Onee-sama doesn’t have sex, what age am I supposed to be before I start doing it?
lines.zh: : 因为,如果你不做,Onee-sama 也不做,那我该到几岁才开始?

lines.en: : Old enough to live on your own at least.
lines.zh: : 至少要大到能独立生活。

lines.en: : We’re in the clear then, Jeeves! I have an apartment! We’re gonna need to keep it down though since I’ve heard how loud that kind of stuff can get.
lines.zh: : 那我们就安全了,Jeeves!我有公寓!不过我们得压低音量——我听说过那种事能有多吵。

lines.en: : I will take that apartment away from you if you’re going to use it for things like that! I meant you must be old enough to buy one! Not have one gifted to you!
lines.zh: : 你要拿它干那种事,我就把公寓收走!我的意思是你必须「自己挣」到能买公寓的年纪!而不是别人白送!

lines.en: : What do you think about this, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你怎么看,Akira?

lines.en: : The same way I felt thirty minutes ago — that I shouldn’t be here and this is weird.
lines.zh: : 和三十分钟前一样——我不该在这里,这很怪。

lines.en: : Because it’s me?...
lines.zh: : 因为是我?……

lines.en: : Yes, but in whatever way is going to hurt your pride the least.
lines.zh: : 是,但会以最不伤你自尊的那种方式。

lines.en: : Sensei, with all due respect, I think this is the perfect moment to hurt Tsukasa’s pride as it has clearly gone out of control.
lines.zh: : Sensei,恕我直言,我认为这正是挫一挫 Tsukasa 锐气的完美时机——它明显已经失控了。

lines.en: : Now, now. The reason we’re doing this at all is for Tsukasa’s sake, dear. She’s very confused and is relying on us to guide her.
lines.zh: : 好了好了。我们做这一切,为的是 Tsukasa,亲爱的。她非常迷茫,正指望我们引导她。

lines.en: : If you take advantage of her vulnerability to insult her, all it will do is make her lash out in the end. This is the exact moment we should be taking her interest to heart.
lines.zh: : 你要是趁她脆弱羞辱她,最终只会让她反抗。这正是我们该认真对待她的好奇心的时刻。

lines.en: : But Mother...her interest is having sex with Sensei. Are you not going to put your foot down?
lines.zh: : 可妈妈……她的兴趣,是和 Sensei 做爱。你不下达禁令吗?

lines.en: : What she wants is a live demonstration, dear. That’s why she asked us first.
lines.zh: : 她想要的是一场现场演示,亲爱的。所以她才先来问我们。

lines.en: : Invite Chinami’s sister over if you have to! Jeeves does it with her all the time, but she won’t even let us stay in the room for it!
lines.zh: : 非要的话,把 Chinami 的姐姐叫来!Jeeves 一直和她做,可她连让我们留在房间里都不肯!

lines.en: : Well, at least someone I know isn’t outright insane.
lines.zh: : 嗯,至少我认识的某人还不是彻底的疯子。

lines.en: : Is there a reason you want to see such a thing up close, Tsukasa? Does a Q&A not suffice to satisfy your curiosities?
lines.zh: : 你有什么理由想近距离看那种东西,Tsukasa?一问一答不能满足你的好奇心吗?

lines.en: : Not while you two are in the room...I have a million questions for Jeeves and it’s just confusing with everybody else grabbing his attention. It’s clearly overwhelming him.
lines.zh: : 只要你们俩都在屋里……我有一百万个问题想问 Jeeves,但大家都在抢他的注意力,只会让人混乱。这明显已经让他不堪重负了。

lines.en: : You’re right. It’s clearly that that’s making him uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。明显是那个让他不舒服。

lines.en: : Why don’t you do it then? You’re the most logical pairing for a live demonstration, darling.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不亲自来?现场演示,你才是最合理的搭配,亲爱的。

lines.en: : Because that’s crazy! You’re being way too casual about this! I don’t want to have my first time in the same room as my family! Have you gone mad?!
lines.zh: : 因为那太疯了!你对这件事的态度太随意了!我不要当着家人的面破身!你疯了吗?!

lines.en: : Hah...okay. Looks like it’ll have to be me after all then.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧。看来终究还是得我来。

lines.en: : Fine! You won’t put your foot down?! I will instead!
lines.zh: : 行!你不肯下禁令是吧?!那我来下!

lines.en: : Come on, Sensei. We’re leaving.
lines.zh: : 走吧,Sensei。我们离开。

lines.en: : Ah! Mother! Stop them! Onee-sama is going to go have sex with Jeeves in private! This is not conducive to a proper learning environment!
lines.zh: : 啊!妈妈!拦住她们!Onee-sama 要和 Jeeves 私下做爱了!这不利于营造良好的学习环境!

lines.en: : The lesson will have to wait, dear. We should let your sister have sex with her teacher in whatever environment makes her feel most comfortable.
lines.zh: : 那一课只能延后了,亲爱的。我们应该让你姐姐用「她觉得最自在的环境」和她的老师做爱。

lines.en: : We will do no such thing! I just don’t want you two badgering him into committing heinous acts for the sake of your education!
lines.zh: : 我们绝不这样做!我只是不想你们俩为了你们的教育,死缠烂打逼他犯下滔天罪行!

lines.en: : You also had a notebook until like five seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 五秒钟前,你手里还拿着笔记本呢。

lines.en: : Being curious is not a sin and I shan’t be judged for it! I know when enough is enough!
lines.zh: : 好奇不是罪,我不该因此被审判!我知道适可而止!

lines.en: : The two of you, though...
lines.zh: : 可你们两个……

lines.en: : This man is not your plaything. He’s an intelligent, creative, and kind human being who desperately wants to be better. And you’re only making that harder for him.
lines.zh: : 这个男人不是你们的玩物。他是一个聪明、有创造力、善良的人,拼命想变得更好。而你们只会让他更难。

lines.en: : Is Akira kind? I’ve never noticed.
lines.zh: : Akira 善良吗?我从没注意到。

lines.en: : He’s nice to me. And very nice to Chinami’s sister. She was loud.
lines.zh: : 他对我很好。对 Chinami 的姐姐非常好。她嗓门很大。

lines.en: : Oh, I’ve heard. That girl is well taken care of.
lines.zh: : 哦,我听说了。那个女孩被照顾得很好。

lines.en: : Disgusting...
lines.zh: : 恶心……

lines.en: : Utterly disgusting...
lines.zh: : 恶心至极……

lines.en: : Thanks for getting me out of there, but...do you really need to keep pulling my hand? I can make it on my own from here.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你把我捞出来,但是……你真的需要一直拽着我的手吗?从这里开始我自己能走。

lines.en: : If I let go, I risk one of them snatching you up and taking you God knows where to do God knows what. I’ll keep my hand right there, thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 我要是松手,风险是她们其中一个把你抢走、带到天知道的地方做天知道的事。我的手就停在这里了,多谢关心。

lines.en: : Just so we’re on the same page here, I really didn’t have much to do with that. Your mom just decided that-
lines.zh: : 我们先把话说开:那件事我真的没怎么参与。是你妈妈决定——

lines.en: : I am better off not knowing the details. They’ll only make me angrier.
lines.zh: : 我还是不知道细节为好。它们只会让我更怒。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: : Jeeves! Onee-sama! Wait for me!
lines.zh: : Jeeves!Onee-sama!等等我!

lines.en: : Hah...how quickly can you run?
lines.zh: : 哈……你能跑多快?

lines.en: : Tsukasa’s not the one you want to be mad at, Touka. We should at least hear her out.
lines.zh: : 你不该生 Tsukasa 的气,Touka。我们至少该听听她怎么说。

lines.en: : I apologize, Sensei — but I find it hard to not be mad at a girl who openly wishes to cuckold me, sister or not.
lines.zh: : 我道歉,Sensei——但我实在很难不恨一个「公然想给我戴绿帽」的女孩,哪怕她是我妹妹。

lines.en: : She doesn’t know what she’s doing. She’s confused and she’s like that because of me.
lines.zh: : 她不知道自己在做什么。她很迷茫,而她之所以这样,是因为我。

lines.en: : Yes, and so am I. But you don’t see me trying to sleep with you in front of my mother.
lines.zh: : 对,我也是。但你看我没有当着我妈妈的面想和你睡。

lines.en: : Guys! Wait! Please!
lines.zh: : 两位!等等!求你们!

lines.en: : Hah...
: I am going to regret this...
lines.zh: : 我要后悔了……

lines.en: : Hah...hah...hah!
: I’ve never had to...run that fast...for anything...in my life!
lines.zh: : 我这辈子……从没为了任何事……跑那么快过!

lines.en: : Did I do...something wrong?! What...was it?! Tell me...and I’ll...do better...next time!
lines.zh: : 我是不是……做错了什么?!是什么?!告诉我……我下次……会做得更好!

lines.en: : Tsukasa-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa——

lines.en: : I really want...to learn!...I don’t...want to be...useless anymore!
lines.zh: : 我真的很想……学!……我不想……再当……废物了!

lines.en: : You’re not useless, Tsukasa...
lines.zh: : 你不是废物,Tsukasa……

lines.en: : But...I am! Onee-sama is...the heir! Mother is...Mother! And I’m just...a tool! Which is fine! That part...is fine!
lines.zh: : 可……我就是!Onee-sama 是……继承人!妈妈是……妈妈!而我只是……一个工具!不过没关系!那部分……没关系!

lines.en: : But if I am...to be a tool...I at least...want to be a good one! I want to know...the things adults know! I want to do...the things adults do!
lines.zh: : 但如果我注定……是个工具……我至少……想当一个好用的!我想知道……大人知道的事!我想做……大人做的事!

lines.en: : I want to...grow up now! So I can see this world...the way you can! Before I’m not a part of it anymore!
lines.zh: : 我想……现在就长大!好让我用你那样的眼光……看这个世界!趁我还是它的一部分!

lines.en: : I’m sorry about Mother too! I wanted to keep her out of this! But I was going to ask you either way, Jeeves! Because you’re the only one who can teach me!
lines.zh: : 妈妈的事我也道歉!我本来想把她排除在外!但无论怎样,我都会来问你,Jeeves!因为你是唯一能教我的人!

lines.en: : Oh, joy. The man I like is the only one who can teach my little sister about sex. I’ll be damned if this isn’t the start of a pornographic film somewhere.
lines.zh: : 哦,真好。我喜欢的那个男人,是唯一能教我妹妹性知识的人。这要不是哪部色情片的开头,我就不叫这个名字。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...I know why you’re trying to rush this whole “growing up” thing...and that’s what I’m trying to fix right now. This all started because of that.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……我知道你为什么急着完成这场「长大」……而那正是我现在想修好的东西。这一切的起因就是它。

lines.en: : Wait...since when do you know about-
lines.zh: : 等等……你从什么时候开始知道——

lines.en: : Don’t interfere, Jeeves.
lines.zh: : 别插手,Jeeves。

lines.en: : This is the one chance I’ve ever had to do something good for this family.
lines.zh: : 这是我这辈子唯一一次,有机会为这个家族做一件好事。

lines.en: : If you take that from me, I will never forgive you.
lines.zh: : 你要是把它夺走,我永远不会原谅你。

lines.en: : That sounds better than never being able to forgive myself for not trying.
lines.zh: : 那也好过永远无法原谅「自己没有试过」。

lines.en: : Why would you?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么会……

lines.en: : Why are you nice to me at all? You have no reason to be. I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 你为什么对我好?你没有任何理由对我好。我不理解。

lines.en: : I just know what it’s like to be rescued at your age. And the idea of being on the opposite end of that is too good to shy away from.
lines.zh: : 我只是知道,在你这个年纪「被救」是什么滋味。而站在拯救的另一端,这个念头好得让我无法回避。

lines.en: : That’s why I’ve done this before — taken someone under my wing when the safer thing to do would be to just push them out of the nest and let them figure things out on their own.
lines.zh: : 这也是我做过这种事的原因——把某个人护在翼下,明明更安全的做法,是把他们推出巢外、让他们自己摸索。

lines.en: : Not all wings are made equally. Some are much sharper than others. Do you know what I mean, Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 但并非所有的翅膀都生而相同。有些比其他的锋利得多。你懂我的意思吗,Tsukasa?

lines.en: : Sensei...I think you should leave now.
lines.zh: : Sensei……我觉得你现在该走了。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I think you’re right.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你说得对。

lines.en: Touka escorts me to the gate while Tsukasa remains in place, watching with tears in her eyes as I fade from her view.
lines.zh: Touka 把我送到大门口,而 Tsukasa 留在原地,眼里含着泪,看着我淡出她的视野。

lines.en: But I will be back.
lines.zh: : 但我会回来的。

lines.en: Whether I want to be or not.
lines.zh: : 不管我愿不愿意。

lines.en: And I will slice up one more fledgling so badly that it will have no choice but to return to its nest forever.
lines.zh: : 而我会把又一只雏鸟割得体无完肤,让它别无选择,只能永远回到巢里。

lines.en: Tsubasa’s affection has increased by 5!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升了 5!

lines.en: Tsukasa’s affection has increased by 10!
lines.zh: Tsukasa 的好感度提升了 10!
